== Pipped links and italics ==

There is no need to put the italics formatting in pipped links. For example, use <nowiki>''[[Rand al'Thor]]'' instead of [[Rand al'Thor|''Rand al'Thor'']]</nowiki>. This will cut down on the keystrokes needed.
